posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
I don't think there's a nwjs-test for linux. You are running an windows app through steam but if I understand correctly, the play test button will still try to call the windows exe.
An alternative is downloading a sdk version of nw.js for your system (e.g., linux 64).
https://dl.nwjs.io/v0.29.0/
There are several ways to do that.
1. You unpack the files into your project folder, and run the executable nw. The problem is when you try to deploy the game, those will will be copied so you have to clean up, not nice.
2. Like step 1, but you move your project into a www sub folder. It should look like this:
You need to copy package.json from nwjs-win folder (check your steam game directory under RPG Maker MV). After that you can run nw to play test the game.
3. You can also run the game in a browser, but I guess you'll need to put the project inside a local web server and input the url to index.html into your browser (not sure how to do that in linux but I doubt it worths the trouble).

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
You know RMMV run games using a program called nw.js right?
In order to do playtest on linux you need to get one for linux.
For example, this one:
https://dl.nwjs.io/v0.29.0/nwjs-sdk-v0.29.0-linux-x64.tar.gz
And yes I mean like a zip file (or in this case, it is a tar.gz file).
There should be a file named nw (see the screenshot I posted), it is the executable for linux.
To make it clear, you can go to your installation folder (where steam installs your game) and check the files there. Under RPG Maker MV, there should be a folder called nwjs-lnx. It contains the files the game will use when you deploy it.
---------------------------------------
is it that I should create a www folder and stick the entire project in there?
Click to expand...
Yes, and after that you need to copy the nw.js sdk files like the screenshot shows.
After that you go to that nwjs-lnx folder(sorry I typed nwjs-win last time because I'm currently using windows) I said above and copy package.json (and Game.desktop if you like) as well.
When you want to do play test, you run nw, or Game.desktop.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
You need to copy package.json from nwjs-lnx
OK let's forget the old steps.
1. Create a www folder inside your project folder, for example, /Project1/www.
2. Move all your project file inside www folder.
3. Get this:
https://dl.nwjs.io/v0.29.0/nwjs-sdk-v0.29.0-linux-x64.tar.gz
4. Extract the files into /Project1
5. Copy package.json and Game.desktop from nwjs-lnx folder into Project1
6. Run nw or Game.desktop to test the game
Your Project1 folder should look like this:
